verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents structured extraction from any page through `page.extract(prompt, schema)` with a JSON schema. A `data_extraction_schema` can also be passed to `run_task`, and runs accept an optional JSON schema for structured output, so it clearly returns schema-shaped data rather than raw text. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that output is validated against the schema (rather than just guided by it), native Zod/Pydantic type integration in the SDKs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of extraction quality.
